book.title: Higher Algebra: A Sequel to Elementary Algebra for Schools
book.publisher: Macmillan and Co., London and New York
book.edition: Fourth Edition, 1891 (title page of the scan reads: First Printed 1887. Second Edition with corrections 1888. Third Edition revised and enlarged 1889. Reprinted 1890. Fourth Edition 1891.)
book.license: Public domain in the United States by publication date (title page dated 1891). The Internet Archive item used here carries no explicit rights statement. A second Internet Archive item of the same title (identifier HIGHERALGEBRA_201906) carries the Creative Commons Public Domain Mark 1.0. Status outside the United States was not verified.

evidence_of_use.strength: weak and indirect; no adoption figures were found
evidence_of_use.summary: Internet Archive metadata for the scanned copy lists the publisher as 'London : Macmillan ; New York : St. Martin's Press' with the description 'Reprinted with corrections in 1964', and the Internet Archive search API reports 127611 downloads for this item. The same search lists a Canadian school edition, 'Algebra for matriculation (senior leaving); being the first xix chapters of Higher Algebra' (1908), and copies from the Digital Library of India (1890, 1924). Web search results (titles and snippets only, pages not opened) list a Macmillan India 1981 edition, an Arihant 'Classic Texts Series' reprint in India, and library catalogue records in the Philippines, Malaysia and Greece.

book.extraction_method: Each statement was read from the page image of the scan (https://archive.org/download/higheralgebraseq00hall/page/n{printed page + 27}_w1000.jpg) and typed out. The OCR text was used only to locate articles. All mathematics in this file is a plain text transcription of typeset formulas.

note: The statements are transcriptions from page images of the scan. Two of the eighteen, Art. 40 and Art. 111, were compared with the page images a second time.
